notes.title: Gauntlet Update
notes.content:
Over 4 years post-launch, and new updates are still coming! The [b]Gauntlet Update[/b] adds:

[list]
[*]Endless Gauntlet mode: The 2nd tournament of each single-player league is now a series of 30 enemies with no healing. Each opponent defeated grants increased coin rewards.
[*]15 new Armors
[*]15 new Helms
[*]15 new Metals
[*]15 new Accent
[*]Balance adjustments
[/list]

notes.title: Armory Update
notes.content: Dozens of new cosmetic options have been added to the Armory, plus you'll find 8 new Sandbox weapons (and a new Sandbox multiplayer mode where you can use them against other players)!

notes.title: Ultimate Update
notes.content:
The [b]ULTIMATE UPDATE[/b] has is the biggest Ironlights update yet, introducing the polearm master [b]Dragoon [/b]and the whip-wielding [b]Scourge[/b].

It also introduces the [b]Sandbox Mode[/b], where you can try out all the weapons that used to be reserved for the AI opponents, plus a couple of new April Fools weapons. Even better, you can record your own AI bots! I recommend [url=https://discord.gg/BECGmxc]joining the community Discord server[/url], where you can find new bots and share your own on the #bot-farm channel.

You’ll also find new helms and other cosmetic options, plus the usual set of balance adjustments, minor features, and bug fixes. [url=http://www.ironlightsgame.com/single-post/the-ultimate-update]Check out the complete changelog here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37094460/759453ce4148dcfe8c83e39045a165165b11af5e.png[/img]

notes.title: The Scythe Update
notes.content:
A new class has entered the arena! The [b]Reaper[/b] is a swift and deadly fighter who wields a grim, heavy scythe. With great reach and a long blade, this fearsome weapon is tough to block and even harder to dodge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37094460/9325035ecad5d16294f515f87fb52f5c6a33809e.png[/img]

The Scythe Update also includes:
[list]
[*]6 new Reaper opponents in the Campaign mode
[*]New Reaper AIs in Training mode
[*]2 new helm cosmetics
[*]First-person mode for exporting GIFs
[*]Tons of balance updates & bug fixes
[/list]
